description: This PHP source file defines a final class PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension that implements PHPStan extension interfaces to provide static analysis support for preg matching functions, offering type inference and method support detection for specific static methods of the Preg class.

classes.name: PregMatchTypeSpecifyingExtension
classes.description: This class extends the PHPStan static method specifying extension to support preg match functions with type inference capabilities. It handles detection of supported methods, type specification based on regex match results, and configuration with a type specifier and regex shape matcher.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a RegexArrayShapeMatcher instance.

methods.name: setTypeSpecifier
methods.description: Sets the type specifier used for type inference.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name (Preg) that this extension supports.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given static method call is supported based on method name and context.

methods.name: specifyTypes
methods.description: Determines the interval type of variables based on the preg match functions called, the regex pattern, flags, and execution context, to facilitate static analysis and type safety.
